attachments.document_title: Notice of termination (letter, message or other record of the notice and its receipt)
attachments.label: A1
attachments.text:
Ms Megan Bachmann
Feldstrasse 35
8200 Schaffhausen

Schaffhausen, 24 November 2025

Notice of termination of employment

Dear Ms Bachmann

We hereby terminate your employment, observing the notice period, with effect from 31 January 2026.

Please take your remaining holidays before that date in agreement with your line manager. Your salary will be paid until the end of your employment, and your reference will be sent to you with your final salary statement.

---
Registered mail. Delivered to the addressee on 26 November 2025.

questions.label: Q1
questions.question: Was the employee, when notice was given, an elected employee representative on the staff council of the business or on a body linked to the business?

questions.label: Q2
questions.question: Did the employee lodge a written objection to the notice with the employer (German: "beim Kündigenden schriftlich Einsprache erheben") no later than the end of the notice period?

questions.label: Q3
questions.question: Did the employee and the employer agree, after the notice, that the employment relationship would continue?

questions.label: Q4
questions.question: Did the employer give the employee notice of termination of the employment relationship?

questions.label: Q5
questions.question: Was the notice given because the employee had asserted, in good faith, claims arising from the employment relationship?

questions.label: Q6
questions.question: Have more than 180 days passed since the employment relationship ended?

questions.label: Q7
questions.question: Did the employee make the compensation claim pending (German: "Klage anhängig gemacht") within 180 days of the end of the employment relationship?

questions.label: Q8
questions.question: Did the employee ask the employer to state the reasons for the notice in writing?

questions.label: Q9
questions.question: Has the notice period (from the notice to the end of the employment relationship) already ended?

text:
Dear Sir or Madam

I'll try to keep this short, although it's been going on for a year now.

After I got my notice there was never any agreement that I'd stay on at Talgrund Trading Ltd. Grace Keller, the director, made it plain the decision was final.

I'm convinced I lost my job because I stood up for myself. In October 2025 I asked Ms Keller in writing to pay me the holiday days I had never been allowed to take, about CHF 1,210 worth. I honestly believed, and still believe, that the money was mine. She was furious, and a few weeks later I had my notice. My colleague Isla Suter heard her say I was 'too expensive with all my demands'.

Just so you know, I was never on the staff committee or any other employee body there. I was an ordinary sales assistant.

I'm attaching the notice letter. It's dated 24 November 2025 and I received it on 26 November. My employment ended on 31 January 2026.

On 1 December 2025 I sent Ms Keller a registered letter asking her to give me the reasons for the notice in writing. The answer was two lines about 'restructuring'.

On 2 June 2026 I filed a claim for compensation with the conciliation authority in Schaffhausen, so about four months after my last day. The hearing was on 17 August 2026 and we didn't reach a settlement, and now I have to decide about the next step.

My last working day was 31 January, which is now about nine months ago, and the notice period has of course long run out.

I earned CHF 2,720 a month. What are my chances if I take this further, and what would it cost?

Kind regards
Megan Bachmann
Feldstrasse 35, Schaffhausen
